# Agent Action Surety (llms.txt)
> Zero-runtime-dependency execution firewall, path sandbox, command interceptor, and tamper-evident audit ledger for AI coding agents.

## Project status
- project: agent-action-surety
- repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-action-surety
- license: MIT
- steward: Nymrel / JalenBuilds LLC
- contact: contact@nymrel.com
- security: security@nymrel.com
- npmPackage: @nymrel/agent-surety (reserved; unpublished)
- pythonPackage: agent-action-surety (reserved; unpublished)
- installStatus: use the reviewed source-install instructions in README.md until trusted registry publication is complete

## Trust boundary
- Surety is an application safety gate, not an OS/container sandbox or credential authority.
- The host remains responsible for least-privilege credentials, process isolation, target authorization, and rollback.
- Default executors avoid shell interpretation and fail closed on malformed command strings.
- Custom executors or explicit shell launchers reintroduce their own execution semantics and must be separately constrained.

## Core capabilities
- Deny-by-default capability policy.
- Filesystem root containment and sensitive-path protection.
- Destructive shell, SQL, Git, cloud, and Kubernetes interception.
- Spend, token, and action-rate bounds.
- SHA-256 hash-chained action receipts with optional HMAC verification.
